failure_modes: target element missing -> throws, naming the id

a skip records null — never a default, never the first option

not_covered: System selects — filters, config, model pickers. A closed list is CORRECT there: those are properties of the software, not claims about a person. Bolting "Something else" onto a particle-density picker would be noise, and noise makes the real rule easier to ignore (§0.5). The lint holds that line with a stated reason per exemption.

The limitation is real — "still there, we just don't talk about it" fits none of open/healing/resolved. Owed: a companion free-text field ALONGSIDE the status, not replacing it.
